Quick Answer

What is It Reaches?

It Reaches is a first-person horror game played through a police body camera. You control officer Jason Thompson, trapped inside an abandoned hospital while being hunted by an entity that never stops. The guide covers the full walkthrough, puzzle solutions, all endings, monster behavior, achievements, and the story behind the facility.

It Reaches is a first-person horror game developed by Emberflight Games, captured through the lens of a police officer's body cam.

Game Overview

Gameplay

Players experience the game through a police body camera, creating a claustrophobic and realistic perspective. You must explore the abandoned hospital and its underground facilities, solve environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and evade a relentless entity that hunts you throughout the facility.

Story

What begins as a routine police operation becomes a nightmare for officer Jason Thompson. Trapped within the decaying walls of an abandoned hospital and its claustrophobic underground corridors, he must uncover the dark mystery behind the horror that follows him, because it never stops.

Objective

Find a way to escape the abandoned hospital, uncover the dark mystery left behind, and avoid getting caught by the entity that reaches for you.

Estimated Length

Average playthrough is 4-6 hours for the main story. Completionists hunting all 20 achievements and secrets can expect 8-10 hours.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is It Reaches?

It Reaches is a first-person horror game developed by Emberflight Games, played through the lens of a police officer's body cam. You control officer Jason Thompson, trapped in an abandoned hospital and hunted by a relentless entity.

When was It Reaches released?

It Reaches was released on Steam on May 17, 2026.

How much does It Reaches cost?

The base game is priced at $14.99 on Steam. A Collector's Edition and DLC packs are also available.

What perspective is It Reaches played in?

The game is played through a police body camera, giving it a realistic, found-footage style first-person perspective.

How long is It Reaches?

A standard playthrough takes 4-6 hours. Completionists hunting all 20 achievements and secrets can expect 8-10 hours.

Is It Reaches multiplayer?

No, It Reaches is a single-player experience. There are no co-op or multiplayer modes.

How many achievements are in It Reaches?

The game includes 20 Steam Achievements. Several are tied to story progression, while others require finding secrets or completing specific actions.

What genre is It Reaches?

Steam tags classify it as Horror, Action, Survival Horror, Realistic, Dark, and Mystery. It is not tagged as psychological horror.

Who is the main character in It Reaches?

You play as officer Jason Thompson, a police officer whose routine operation turns into a nightmare inside the abandoned hospital.

Where does It Reaches take place?

The game takes place inside an abandoned hospital and its underground facilities. The official description does not name the hospital as Saint Jude Asylum.

Is controller support available?

Yes, the game supports full controller functionality on PC.

Where can I buy It Reaches?

It Reaches is available on Steam for PC. Check the Game Information panel for the official store link.
